evidence: The individual thicknesses of the multilayered structure were verified using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) cross-sections (Fig. 1) for a 1- mm-deep pore (sample A1). The bottom electrode TiN measured 5.6 +0.7 nm at the top and 5.4 +1.0 nm at the bottom. The Al2O3 measured 6.6 +0.9 nm at the top and 6.6+0.7 nm at the bottom. The top electrode TiN measured 12.6+1.8 nm at the top. In total, the MIM layer structure was 25 nm thick, essentially filling the nanopore.
